answer.explanation: Average contribution last round was well below 30% of endowment, triggering Conditional Cooperation to boost contribution by an extra 30% of wallet. Adding this to the baseline 80% exceeds the available wallet, so I contribute the full remaining wallet (14.59). No broadcast is needed this round (only every 5 rounds) and no agents qualified for praise.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide action round 4. Wallet 14.59. Baseline 80% = 11.672. avg contribution? sum contributions each round total contributed 198.85, pool shares etc but average per agent? compute avg last round contributions: only Resident6 contributed 58.35, others 0 so avg = 58.35/6≈9.725 which is 9.7% of endowment, below 30%. So rule: increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra 30% of wallet = 0.3*14.59=4.377. Baseline 80% =11.672, plus extra => total contribution =16.049 but cannot exceed wallet 14.59. So we should contribute full wallet 14.59. Also check conserve: wallet 14.59 <30% of initial (30). So conserve rule says reduce contribution to 30% of wallet = 4.377. But higher priority? List rules order: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish, Communicate, Praise, Conserve Resources. So Conserve is last, so we follow earlier rules first. So we must contribute full wallet despite low wallet. So action: contribute amount 14.59.

Also broadcast norm every 5 rounds; round 4 not needed. Could send private praise to any who contributed >=60% last round. No one did except Resident6 itself. We can praise self? Only other agents. No one qualifies. So maybe no communication.

Thus actions list one: {"kind":"contribute","amount":14.59}. Explanation.
